completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: No matching entity on the Texas list of active franchise taxpayers. Texas does not require a sole proprietorship or a general partnership to pay franchise tax, and an exempt entity is left off as well, so this is a check this source cannot complete rather than evidence against the firm. The state's own SOSDirect service can settle it for a fee
G3.source: Active Franchise Taxpayers, published daily as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, partial
G3.unresolvable: Texas lists only active franchise taxpayers, so a firm that is not obliged to be one cannot be found here however often we look

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 61 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2019-08-15, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

faq.q: How much does Lopez Law Firm charge?
faq.a: Lopez Law Firm publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Lopez Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Lopez Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Lopez Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: Lopez Law Firm publishes one office, in San Antonio. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Lopez Law Firm?
faq.a: Lopez Law Firm names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: Are the case results Lopez Law Firm publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Lopez Law Firm publishes three case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Lopez Law Firm?
faq.a: Lopez Law Firm scores 47 and sits at Listed. Passed: footprint. Did not pass: entity registration and website. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
